memories.content: [Context Note] Similar tasks have benefited from first confirming the imaging view and orientation markers before judging laterality, since viewer-left does not always equal patient-left. One approach that worked before was tracing the device trajectory to a canonical anatomical landmark and reconciling apparent left/right conflicts using standard conventions.

metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?
Options: {"A": "left indwelling catheter", "B": "right indwelling catheter"}
metadata.retrieval_focus: Identifying and localizing medical devices or lines in imaging by comparing left versus right anatomical placement and distinguishing similar-appearing structures.
